messages.subject: Shiny App Deploy Error with dplyr
parts:
I'm trying to upload an app on Shiny, but I'm having issues deploying it on their server. While it was previously working, now that I've begun using dpylr I'm getting errors as I attempt to upload it. It starts installing it fine, then begins to load the packages for dplyr. Then I hit an error:


Error: package �Rcpp� 0.11.6 was found, but >= 0.12.0 is required by �dplyr� * removing �/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/dplyr�

############################# End Log ###################################

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 80745937 failed: Error building image: Error building dplyr (0.4.3). Build exited with non-zero status: 1 Execution halted


Any thoughts on this? I'm assuming some of the libraries for dpylr aren't being read correctly. Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Shiny App Deploy Error with dplyr
parts:
Hi,

I think you should try updating your versions of Rcpp and dplyr to the latest available on CRAN.


Cheers
-Andy
